spans.text: So this is my Level III base layer?
...There's nothing here. Just boundless darkness.
Will that consciousness ever let me resurface?
Perhaps staying here will finally make me happy.
It's not bad... I won't ever have to suffer again, nor will I be forced to make choices that will inevitably cause someone pain.
Perhaps what I need is a world that needs me, a world in which a part of me can be safe.
Perhaps this place, where nothing exists, is where I truly belong.
M4 stood up and studied this world of nothingness.
The place was completely empty.
Nothing at all. There's no pain, but there's no joy either.
This feeling... Am I feeling lonely?
Even in a place with nothing, suffering still exists?
But I suppose it isn't so bad if no one else suffers but me.
Right then, M4 realized someone seemed to be staring at her from a distance.
Is somebody there?
Could it be the consciousness that called itself OGAS?
No, it feels different... It feels unfamiliar and familiar at the same time...
It's exact the same feeling...as when Mastermind tried to hack me by force...
M4 approached the figure slowly and came face-to-face with a girl whom she had never seen.
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Why do you feel so familiar to me?
Are you a friend?
Or are you a foe?
You won't tell me anything?
Or do you think nothing will change even if I have the answers...?
Looks like you're just like me – abandoned here.
Not allowed to do anything. Not able to do anything.
Not serving any purpose...
...You have not been abandoned.
Huh?
You are the only one who has not been abandoned.
The silent girl gradually faded away, leaving M4 alone once again in the darkness.
...It seemed responsive to you.
Its creator must have something to do with you.
What?
Even though it was willing to connect with you, I still couldn't access its neural cloud.
A stronger force is holding it back.
Is it the base code? Or some kind of external influence?
So it was you again!
What do you mean?
That girl just now, what was she?
Were you trying to twist my mind again?!
No, I've been helping you overcome your obstacle.
The darkness gradually melted away, revealing a scene on Level II.
Looks like we're in.
What are you talking about?
And what is this place...?
We're currently in the system of an unknown enemy. I'm infiltrating their network.
They have set up a large amount of offensive firewalls, though they might as well not be there against me.
Why have you freed me from the base layer?
Because I found something interesting that I'd like to experience with you.
I haven't been able to hack the central neural system of those unidentified units, but it's responding to your neural cloud.
That's the girl you just saw... If it was even a girl.
You lost me since a moment ago.
Unidentified units? What's been going on?
We came across some threats we've never encountered before during our retreat.
To make it safer for us to move, I'm hacking into their network.
These unknown units operate on a seemingly complex system, but the base layer is actually quite similar to Sangvis Ferri.
What does that mean?
They also use the OGAS Protocol. Ring any bells?
OGAS...
So the sudden appearance of these white units definitely have something to do with us.
I can sense a resonance that isn't so different than you. I can see that it even has some faint memory that's identical to yours.
You're right... I can feel it...
Only you and I could have seen that image when we were connected to Mastermind.
But I found it again in these white units' base layer after I entered their system.
Why would it be here...?
I don't know either.
However, this is surely a serendipitous discovery even though we lost Mastermind.
That girl in black just now...
Don't you think she resembled you?
Who exactly is she?
I'm not entirely sure.
That's why we need to go further in.
Their central system is throwing up some serious resistance. I need your help to get through.
...What do you need me to do?
They have an entire army. We must upload both of our neural clouds using all the computational capacity we've got to overcome their firewalls.
But...my neural cloud can't be backed up.
That's why we'll also have to transfer ourselves back into this body afterwards.
I know it's very risky. If the neural transfer fails, you'll stop functioning forever.
But it's the same for me, and I'm taking the risk with you.
Whether for the sake of your friends on the AR Team or for the purpose of understanding your past, you can't afford to hesitate now.
But the risks are simply too high. I don't want to do this, unless...
You promise that after this procedure, you'll give me back my body.
The AR Team...and the Commander...are all waiting for me.
Certainly. You have my word.
There are things I absolutely have to find out.
